{{Quote|I am al'Lan Mandragoran... Lord of the Seven Towers, Defender of the Wall of First Fires, Bearer of the Sword of the Thousand Lakes!... I may be a king without a land. '''But I am still King!'''|[[Lan Mandragoran]]}}
{{dablink|For other uses of the word "sword," see [[Sword]].}}
'''Bearer of the Sword of the Thousand Lakes''' is a title [[Lan Mandragoran]] claimed for himself just prior to ordering his army of twelve thousand to charge one hundred fifty thousand [[Shadowspawn]] at [[Tarwin's Gap]].

Though no specific mention of a Sword of the Thousand Lakes is made in the histories, [[Malkier]] was described as "a kingdom necklaced by a thousand lakes."  The same document also reports that prior to moving him out of the country, Lan was given the ancient sword of the Malkieri kings; a [[Power-wrought]] blade.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 28}} It is likely then that the sword given to him as a babe in arms was that same Sword of a Thousand Lakes that he cites as he claims this title.
